_doc: Judgement calls for the coverage scorecard (scripts/catalogue.py). Default: all rows yes = complete, some reached = gap, none = none. Overrides here only where the map's 'partly' is a minor gap, or where Fontes has everything the court publishes but that is thin.

gb: UK Supreme Court from 2009 in full; House of Lords before that is on BAILII only
fi: precedents (KKO) only; other decisions not built
np: Nepal Kanoon Patrika precedents; Nepali only
pt: DGSI is the official selection; some summary-only
rs: the court publishes selected anonymised decisions only
sr: the court publishes selected anonymised decisions only
ci: THIN: the court publishes only ~100 judgments online
cm: THIN: the court publishes only a few dozen judgments online
cv: THIN: the court publishes only ~360 selected judgments online
tm: THIN: only Plenum guiding resolutions are published
al: full-text search from 2005; 1999–2004 monthly volumes browse-only

hk: current versions only; past versions robots-blocked
lu: ~1,400 acts consolidated, the rest as originally published
ad: decrets legislatius reached through the consolidated law texts (text refós)
us: US Code (all general and permanent law) + Constitution; uncodified Statutes at Large not built
